goal: Count, read, write and order 1 to 5.

teacher_modelling.welcome: Hello! I am Ms Binta. Today we will learn how to count.
teacher_modelling.prepare: Ask an adult to put some large, unbreakable cups on a table.
teacher_modelling.watch: Watch me touch each cup once. Listen: one, two, three.
teacher_modelling.total: The last number I said was three. There are three cups.
teacher_modelling.together: Touch each cup picture and count with me. The number beside each group tells how many cups.
teacher_modelling.recall: What did I show you? Tell a partner. Then show your way of counting.

assessments.heading: Count the row
assessments.prompt: Touch each cup picture once. Count aloud. Write how many.
assessments.rubric: Three cups; one touch and one number word per cup.

assessments.heading: Count this group
assessments.prompt: Touch each cup picture once. Count aloud. Write how many.
assessments.rubric: Five cups, despite their different positions.

assessments.heading: Draw to show how many
assessments.prompt: Draw a circle for each cup. You will draw two circles.
assessments.rubric: Two separate circles, one for each cup picture.

assessments.heading: Write the numbers
assessments.prompt: Trace the numbers. Then write them in the empty boxes.
assessments.rubric: The numerals one to five in order; observe independent formation separately from tracing.

assessments.heading: Show with your hand
assessments.prompt: Hold up four fingers. Count them. Write how many.
assessments.rubric: Four fingers and the numeral 4. Accept a set of four objects if a hand response is unsuitable.

assessments.heading: Help Adamu start again
assessments.prompt: Adamu touched a cup twice. Show him how to count each cup just once.
assessments.source_answer: Touch or move each top exactly once.
assessments.rubric: Touch or move each cup exactly once, say one number per cup, and state three cups. Explain or demonstrate without requiring written prose.

fresh_check: Without a model, put four cups on the table for Ms Binta. Then identify a spoken numeral among shuffled cards.
later_recall: On another day ask what Ms Binta showed the class. Invite a demonstration with a fresh small set before showing the model again.
preservation_note: The teacher guide retains the six original question IDs and mathematical answer correspondence. Cups replace tops or abstract dots in the isolated teaching sample; canonical lesson files and old edition remain untouched.
